fields.Name: LLM Decision
fields.Description: Answers typed decisions (Likelihood, Choice, Score) with a chat model, through the LLM Decision prompt. It is the fallback when no native decision model is available or configured: slower and less consistent than a native decision model, but it needs no extra vendor account.

Calibrations.Question: continues
Calibrations.FittedOn: Phase 2 Decision Eval, conversation-routing cell 'production', 2026-09-29, via Cerebras: 301 scored points, 5 repeats. Out of fold: balanced accuracy 0.796 raw → 0.861 calibrated, ECE 0.195 → 0.081. Fitted at the corpus mix (42% continue), then B shifted by logit(0.9) − logit(127/301) = +2.5121 to a chat's 90%-continue mix (B at the corpus mix: -2.911).

Calibrations.Question: agent
Calibrations.FittedOn: Agent-discovery Decision Eval, 2026-09-29: 258 requests × 3 repeats (GPT-OSS-120B answered all 774 runs). At a calibrated 0.85: at least 16.0% coverage at 92.6% precision.
